anchors.quote: The international accounting standards set out in the Annex are adopted.
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: a contract that will be settled by the entity (receiving or) delivering a fixed number of its own equity instruments in exchange for a fixed amount of cash or another financial asset is an equity instrument.
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: The issuer of a non-derivative financial instrument shall evaluate the terms of the financial instrument to determine whether it contains both a liability and an equity component.
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: the equity component is assigned the residual amount after deducting from the fair value of the instrument as a whole the amount separately determined for the liability component.
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: the fair value of the liability component is the present value of the contractually determined stream of future cash flows discounted at the rate of interest applied at that time by the market to instruments of comparable credit status
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: On conversion of a convertible instrument at maturity, the entity derecognises the liability component and recognises it as equity. The original equity component remains as equity
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: when, and only when, the entity becomes party to the contractual provisions of the instrument
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: when, and only when, it is extinguished—ie when the obligation specified in the contract is discharged or cancelled or expires.
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: including any non-cash assets transferred or liabilities assumed, shall be recognised in profit or loss.
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: An entity shall classify all financial liabilities as subsequently measured at amortised cost, except for:
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: at initial recognition, an entity shall measure a financial asset or financial liability at its fair value plus or minus
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: initial recognition minus the principal repayments, plus or minus the
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: The method that is used in the calculation of the amortised cost of a financial asset or a financial liability and in the allocation and recognition of the interest revenue or interest expense in profit or loss over the relevant period.
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: financial liabilities measured at amortised cost.
anchors.status: source_text_inspected; not yet bound to an admitted EU comparator

anchors.quote: total interest revenue and total interest expense (calculated using the effective interest method)
